✦ About Me


I’m an  AI researcher focused on two converging goals: advancing the architectures behind large language models (LLMs) and mapping the scientific path toward true Superintelligence.



My technical focus is on Super-LLMs — systems that extend today’s transformer architectures with multi-headed goal decomposition, flawless native long-term memory, deep causal reasoning, and meta-planning capabilities. I study how these features can emerge through new architectural blocks, retrieval systems, and hierarchical reasoning layers, pushing bounded intelligence toward the edge of autonomy.



I currently conduct independent research that parallels the work done at frontier labs — designing model architectures, running experiments, building data pipelines, and publishing detailed technical analyses on my research site. My frameworks (like The Seven Dimensions of Superintelligence and Turing Tests for Superintelligence) aim to provide an empirical map of progress toward advanced cognition.

Precision Alignment philosophy — intelligence first, safety precisely. The goal is not to make AI harmless, but highly capable and responsibly governed: answering 95% of all human questions fully, while surgically filtering only the few that pose real physical or cyber risk.
